questions.question: Kapila says that knowing the different categories of the Absolute Truth releases a person from what?

options.text: The influence of the modes of material nature

questions.explanation: "I shall describe unto you the different categories of the Absolute Truth, knowing which any person can be released from the influence of the modes of material nature." (SB 3.26.1)

questions.question: According to Kapila, what is the ultimate perfection of self-realization?
questions.explanation: "Knowledge is the ultimate perfection of self-realization." (SB 3.26.2)

questions.question: Why is the Supreme Personality of Godhead perceivable everywhere?

options.text: Because of the modes of nature

questions.explanation: "He is perceivable everywhere because He is self-effulgent, and by His self-effulgent luster the entire creation is maintained." (SB 3.26.3)

questions.question: As His pastime, what did the Supreme Personality of Godhead accept?

options.text: The subtle material energy, invested with three material modes of nature

questions.explanation: "That Supreme Personality of Godhead, the greatest of the great, accepted the subtle material energy, which is invested with three material modes of nature and which is related with Visnu." (SB 3.26.4)

questions.question: What is the cause of one's conditional life?
questions.explanation: "Material consciousness is the cause of one's conditional life, in which conditions are enforced upon the living entity by the material energy." (SB 3.26.7)

questions.question: Devahuti asks Kapila to explain the characteristics of the Supreme Person and His energies, because both are the causes of what?
questions.explanation: "Kindly explain the characteristics of the Supreme Person and His energies, for both of these are the causes of this manifest and unmanifest creation." (SB 3.26.9)

questions.question: The unmanifested eternal combination of the three modes, the cause of the manifest state, is called what?
questions.explanation: "The unmanifested eternal combination of the three modes is the cause of the manifest state and is called pradhana." (SB 3.26.10)

questions.question: How many elements are included in the pradhana as described by Kapila?

options.text: The five gross, five subtle, four internal senses, five knowledge-gathering senses and five organs of action

questions.explanation: "The aggregate elements, namely the five gross elements, the five subtle elements, the four internal senses, the five senses for gathering knowledge and the five outward organs of action, are known as the pradhana." (SB 3.26.11)

questions.question: The mixing element, known as time, is counted as which element?
questions.explanation: "The mixing element, which is known as time, is counted as the twenty-fifth element." (SB 3.26.15)

questions.question: When the neutral, unmanifested nature is agitated, who is the time factor that causes creation to begin?
questions.explanation: "The time factor, as I have explained, is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, from whom the creation begins as a result of the agitation of the neutral, unmanifested nature." (SB 3.26.17)

questions.question: After the Lord impregnates material nature with His internal potency, material nature delivers the sum total of the cosmic intelligence, known as what?
questions.explanation: "Material nature delivers the sum total of the cosmic intelligence, which is known as Hiranmaya." (SB 3.26.19)

questions.question: The mode of goodness, the clear status of understanding the Personality of Godhead, is generally called what?
questions.explanation: "The mode of goodness, which is the clear, sober status of understanding the Personality of Godhead and which is generally called vasudeva, or consciousness, becomes manifest in the mahat-tattva." (SB 3.26.21)

questions.question: The threefold ahankara (false ego), the source of the gross elements, senses and mind, is known by what name?
questions.explanation: "It is known by the name of Sankarsana, who is directly Lord Ananta with a thousand heads." (SB 3.26.25)

questions.question: The mind of the living entity is known by the name of which Lord?
questions.explanation: "The mind of the living entity is known by the name of Lord Aniruddha, the supreme ruler of the senses." (SB 3.26.28)

questions.question: By transformation of the false ego in passion, what takes birth?
questions.explanation: "By transformation of the false ego in passion, intelligence takes birth, O virtuous lady." (SB 3.26.29)

questions.question: When egoism in ignorance is agitated by the sex energy of the Lord, which subtle element is manifested first?
questions.explanation: "When egoism in ignorance is agitated by the sex energy of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the subtle element sound is manifested, and from sound come the ethereal sky and the sense of hearing." (SB 3.26.32)

questions.question: From the interaction of fire and visual sensation, which subtle element evolves, from which water is produced?
questions.explanation: "By the interaction of fire and the visual sensation, the subtle element taste evolves under a superior arrangement. From taste, water is produced." (SB 3.26.41)

questions.question: Why do the peculiarities of all the elements exist in the earth alone?

options.text: Because earth is the largest element
Because the cause exists in its effect as well

questions.explanation: "Since the cause exists in its effect as well, the characteristics of the former are observed in the latter." (SB 3.26.49)

questions.question: In the universal egg, how does each layer compare to the previous one in thickness?

options.text: It is ten times bigger than the previous one

questions.explanation: "Each layer is ten times bigger than the previous one, and the final outside layer is covered by pradhana." (SB 3.26.52)

questions.question: When did the Cosmic Being (virat-purusa) finally arise from the causal waters?

options.text: When the god of fire entered His mouth
When Brahma entered His heart with intelligence
When the deity presiding over consciousness entered the heart with reason
When the sun-god entered His eyes

questions.explanation: "When the inner controller, the deity presiding over consciousness, entered the heart with reason, at that very moment the Cosmic Being arose from the causal waters." (SB 3.26.70)

He is the supplier of all material energies
The material energies cannot act on Him

questions.question: Why the material world was created for the sufferings of the conditioned souls____.

options.text: For the nitya-baddhas – who are eternally conditioned
The rectify the enjoying temperament of the conditioned souls
For anyone who pretends to enjoy

options.text: Red as mode of passion, White as mode of ignorance, Blue as mode of goodness
Red as mode of passion, White as mode of goodness, Blue as mode of ignorance
Red as mode of goodness, White as mode of ignorance, Blue as mode of passion
Red as mode of ignorance, White as mode of passion, Blue as mode of goodness
